cleanup.normal: Owned Java exited, broker state and credential/JAAS files removed; retained textual logs checked against generated passwords
cleanup.interrupted_prototype: Run-owned VM became unresponsive with concurrent diagnostic/distributed workloads. Only that VM was restarted; prototype secrets/data removed and retained logs sanitized. Interrupted scenarios are not accepted.
cleanup.interruption: The final case creates an independently owned authenticated secure fixture, cancels its active bracket, observes ThreadKilled, and asserts all owned process handles exited and secret/config/data directories were removed.
